claims.label: Butch Hibbs attended UVU 9/10 with a front-row seat arranged through Charlie Kirk
claims.claim: In a Fox News audio interview, Jack Hibbs stated that his brother Butch received a front-row seat to the UVU event directly from Charlie Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm UVU event seating assignments, verify whether the seat location matches photographs, and corroborate with event staff or seating manifests.

claims.label: Jack Hibbs stated he learned of Charlie Kirk's death from an Israeli news service shortly after the shooting
claims.claim: In a Facebook video, Jack Hibbs stated he first learned Charlie Kirk had died "shortly after Charlie was shot from Israeli news service," adding "How they knew, but they knew."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific Israeli outlet(s) referenced; review Israeli media's early reporting timeline; determine whether/how they obtained information before official announcement.

claims.label: Jack Hibbs stated his brother Butch called him the night before 9/10 to request a UVU ticket
claims.claim: In an interview with Frank Turek, Jack Hibbs described receiving a call from his brother Butch the night before the UVU event, asking to attend and be introduced to Charlie Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Butch Hibbs's phone records for the night of 9/9–9/10 to verify the timing and content of the call to Jack Hibbs.

claims.label: Butch Hibbs recorded footage on his phone within seconds of the shooting
claims.claim: The host says never-before-seen footage she plays shows Butch Hibbs briefly dipping down, presumably to open his camera app, and recording multiple angles of the scene within seconds of the shot, while remaining in place near the tent.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original device with full metadata; determine total duration and any transmissions; compare timestamps to corroborate against other event footage.

claims.label: Jack Hibbs stated that Mikey McCoy called him before the FaceTime with Frank Turek
claims.claim: In a second interview clip with Frank Turek, Jack Hibbs stated he first received a call from Mikey McCoy, who said "get everyone in the world praying," before the FaceTime with Turek began.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference Mikey McCoy's call logs (previously referenced as covering 12:24–12:44) for any call to a Jack Hibbs number; reconcile with the 12:30 PM prayer-chain claim.

claims.label: In Clip Host Plays, Jack Hibbs Says He Initially Confused Charlie Kirk With a Relative Named "Cousin Charlie"
claims.claim: In a clip of his conversation with Frank Turek that the host plays, Jack Hibbs says that when his brother called to say "Charlie's been shot," he briefly thought a relative named Charlie, "cousin Charlie," had been shot, not Charlie Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the existence of a Jack Hibbs relative commonly known as "Charlie"; assess whether the confusion is plausible given family context and call conditions.

claims.label: Jack Hibbs placed the prayer-chain timing at approximately 12:30 PM Utah, roughly seven minutes after the shooting
claims.claim: Per Jack Hibbs's account, a prayer chain was underway at approximately 12:30 PM Utah time, which the host calculates as only about seven minutes after Charlie Kirk was shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish the precise timestamp of the shooting from primary sources; corroborate hospital transport timeline; assess feasibility of FaceTime hospital contact within the stated window.

claims.label: Host Says Butch Hibbs Was on a Phone Call About Five Minutes After the Shooting, Not Visibly Distressed
claims.claim: The host says a still from UVU footage shows Butch Hibbs on what looks to be a phone call about five minutes after the shot, and she says he does not look visibly upset.
claims.investigative_direction: Attempt to identify call recipient via phone records; cross-reference with Jack Hibbs's stated call timeline (cousin-Charlie call).

claims.label: Host Says Butch Hibbs Is 74 Years Old
claims.claim: The host says Jack Hibbs's brother Butch is 74 years old.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm Butch Hibbs's date of birth and verify against any ID or background checks.

claims.label: Host Says Judge Graf Was to Rule on Tyler Robinson Preliminary Hearing Decision on the Broadcast Date
claims.claim: The host says Judge Graf is the magistrate who was to rule that day, September 1, 2026, on the defense motion to dismiss charges 1, 6, and 7 in the Tyler Robinson case, i.e., on whether there was enough preliminary evidence to move the case to trial.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the magistrate's full name through Utah court records; obtain the written ruling once filed.

claims.label: A prayer chain / coordinated Calvary Chapel communication may have begun during the active emergency window
claims.claim: The host says it seems implausible that Mikey McCoy called Pastor Jack Hibbs before 12:30 given his call logs, and suggests that perhaps there was a Calvary Chapel conference call.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare timestamps across all Calvary Chapel-linked calls and messages to determine whether communication pattern reflects coordinated response or independent contact.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Kirk, Charlie Kirk's Parents, Stacy Sheridan, Tracy Martin, Andrew Kolvet, and Pastor James Kaddis Were at the Courthouse on Decision Day
claims.claim: The host says courthouse cameras captured Charlie Kirk's parents, Stacy Sheridan, Tracy Martin, Andrew Kolvet, and Pastor James Kaddis arriving at the courthouse for Judge Graf's decision, and that Erika Kirk was present but was not captured walking in.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference courthouse visitor logs; reconcile with official attendee lists if released.

claims.label: Host Reads Mathematician Email Putting Baldoni Iceland Meeting at One in 80 Million
claims.claim: The host reads an email from a self-described mathematician who estimates about a one in 80 million chance that she would have met Justin Baldoni and his wife, the odds question she says she posed the day before about running into him in Iceland.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the host's prior-episode question and the original email; the odds figure is the correspondent's estimate and is not independently checkable.
claims.transcript_snippet: It's an approximate the probability about one in 80 million chance that you met Justin Baldoni and his wife.

claims.label: Host Says Jennica Pounds Resembles Tyler Robinson and Cites No Positive Evidence It Was Not Her on the Staircase
claims.claim: The host says Data Republican (Jennica Pounds), who she says attacked her for investigating the case, looks very much like Tyler Robinson and says she has no positive evidence that it was not Pounds on the UVU staircase.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Pounds' documented whereabouts on September 10, 2025 with the UVU campus timeline; the host offers no affirmative evidence that Pounds was present.
claims.transcript_snippet: I have no positive evidence that it wasn't Jennica Pounds that was walking up that staircase at UVU.

claims.label: Host Says Turning Point USA Influencers Skipped the Decision-Day Courthouse
claims.claim: The host says the Turning Point USA influencers, such as Graham Allen and Benny Johnson, did not show up at the courtroom for the decision day, unlike the preliminary hearing.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare courtroom pool footage and attendee lists from decision day against the July preliminary hearing sign-in or press seating.
claims.transcript_snippet: No Graham Allen, no Benny Johnson to tell us how overwhelmed we should be.

claims.label: Host Says Stacy Sheridan Heads TPUSA Donations and Tracy Martin Does Erika's PR
claims.claim: The host says Stacy Sheridan is the head of Turning Point USA donations and gifts, and that Tracy Martin does Erika Kirk's PR work.
claims.investigative_direction: Check TPUSA staff and org records for Sheridan's title and Martin's contracted or informal PR role for Erika Kirk.
claims.transcript_snippet: Head of Turning Point USA donations and gifts, always there. Tracy Martin, I'm counting that as dad. She does Erika's PR dirty work.

claims.label: Host Says Pastor James Kaddis Is Senior Pastor at Calvary Chapel Signal Hill and a TPUSA Faith Pastor
claims.claim: The host says Pastor James Kaddis is the senior pastor of Calvary Chapel in Signal Hill, California, and one of Erika Kirk's many TPUSA faith pastors.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Calvary Chapel Signal Hill staff listings and TPUSA Faith advisory rosters for Kaddis (transcript spelling).
claims.transcript_snippet: He's the senior pastor of Calvary Chapel in Signal Hill, California. He is also one of Erika Kirk's many problematic TPUSA faith pastors.

claims.label: Host Says Kaddis Hosts a Show With Erika Kirk for Her Bible 365 Brand
claims.claim: The host says Kaddis hosts a show with Erika Kirk tied to what the host calls Erika's fledgling fashion brand, BIBLEin365.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the show and brand by name and confirm Kaddis' role from the brand's own channels.
claims.transcript_snippet: He also hosts a show with her with that like fledgling, you know, fashion brand that she has, BIBLEin365.

claims.label: Host Says Mikey McCoy Walked Away Without Calling 911 and Phoned His Wife, Erika, Then His Father
claims.claim: The host says Mikey McCoy calmly walked away from the shooting without dialing 911, and instead phoned his wife, then Erika Kirk, then his father Rob McCoy.
claims.investigative_direction: Match the sequence against Mikey McCoy's phone records and the 911 call log.
claims.transcript_snippet: Mikey McCoy calmly walks away. He does not dial 911, but instead phones his wife, followed by Erika, then his father, Pastor Rob McCoy

claims.label: Host Says Mikey McCoy Phoned a Second Pastor for Prayer That Day
claims.claim: The host says Rob McCoy told the story that his son asked him to pray, and that Mikey McCoy turned out to have phoned another pastor that day asking for prayer, setting up Jack Hibbs.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Mikey McCoy's call records to confirm any call to a Hibbs number and its time.
claims.transcript_snippet: Rob McCoy, his father, is not the only pastor that he phoned on that day asking for a prayer.

claims.label: Host Says Mikey McCoy Met Butch Hibbs at UVU and They Walked Charlie In Together
claims.claim: The host says Mikey McCoy, on arriving at UVU with Charlie Kirk, met up with Butch Hibbs, and that they walked Charlie in together with security.
claims.investigative_direction: Review UVU arrival and walk-in video to confirm Butch Hibbs' position relative to Charlie Kirk and Mikey McCoy.
claims.transcript_snippet: Mikey McCoy, when he arrived at UVU with Charlie, also met up with a man named Butch Hibbs. They walked Charlie in together.

claims.label: Host Says Online Speculation Held Butch Hibbs Was Undercover and Carried a Rode Microphone
claims.claim: The host says online chatter speculated that Butch Hibbs was undercover and may have carried a Rode microphone in his top pocket, and that she did not propagate those theories.
claims.investigative_direction: Zoom on the high-resolution pre-event photo of Butch Hibbs' shirt pocket; the host attributes the theory to others and disclaims it.
claims.transcript_snippet: a lot of conspiracies that were drummed up regarding whether or not he was in fact undercover, particularly whether or not, as some people speculated, he may have been carrying a Rode microphone in his top pocket.

claims.label: Host Says Online Sleuths Looked Into Butch Hibbs' Residence and a Flight to Tennessee
claims.claim: The host says many people looked into where Butch Hibbs lives and a flight he potentially took to Tennessee, and that her team did not engage in proliferating those conspiracies.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify any public flight or residence record only if it can be sourced; the host explicitly sets these aside.
claims.transcript_snippet: There were a lot of people looking into where he lives in Hebrew City, a flight that was potentially taken to Tennessee.

claims.label: Host Says Butch Hibbs Was Born Burton Hibbs Jr. and Is Pastor Jack Hibbs' Brother
claims.claim: The host says Butch Hibbs was born Burton Hibbs Jr., comes from a military family, and is the brother of Pastor Jack Hibbs, senior pastor of Calvary Chapel in Chino Hills.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Utah and California records for Burton Hibbs Jr. and any military service of the Hibbs family.
claims.transcript_snippet: Butch Hibbs, born Burton Hibbs, Jr., he is from a military family. His brother is Pastor Jack Hibbs, another senior pastor at Calvary Chapel Church.

claims.label: Host Says She First Heard of Jack Hibbs From Marissa Streit, Who Suggested Him as a Guest

claims.label: Host Says Marissa Streit Was in Unit 8200 and Has Not Hidden It
